title: Recommending Dishes and Comparing Foods
summary: Explaining tastes, recommending dishes, and comparing food preferences.
whyItMatters: A useful food recommendation describes flavor and texture, checks preferences or restrictions, and explains why a dish fits.

mentalModel.title: Ask before recommending
mentalModel.content: Clarify taste, hunger, dietary needs, and desired experience.

mentalModel.title: Describe, compare, justify
mentalModel.content: Use concrete sensory language and a reason tied to the listener.

ruleBlocks.title: Check preferences and restrictions
ruleBlocks.content: Ask about ingredients, allergies, diet, and spice level.

ruleBlocks.title: Use sensory evidence
ruleBlocks.content: Describe taste, aroma, texture, temperature, and richness.

ruleBlocks.title: Tie the recommendation to the person
ruleBlocks.content: Explain why the dish fits and mention relevant limitations.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Mögen Sie es eher mild oder würzig?
Wenn Sie ... mögen, würde ich ... empfehlen.

examples.de: Wenn Sie würzige Gerichte mögen, würde ich das Curry empfehlen.
examples.en: If you like spicy dishes, I would recommend the curry.

examples.de: Im Vergleich zur Suppe ist der Eintopf kräftiger und sättigender.
examples.en: Compared with the soup, the stew is stronger and more filling.

examples.de: Das Gericht ist vegan, enthält aber Nüsse.
examples.en: The dish is vegan but contains nuts.

commonMistakes.correct: State for whom and by which criteria it is suitable.
Ask about restrictions and name relevant ingredients.

comparisons.summary: Preparation vocabulary supports accurate dish descriptions.
Result clauses explain how methods create flavor and texture.
